newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - LCI International started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - LCI International started.

text.p: HSBC James Capel analyst initiated coverage of LCI International Inc Tuesday with a buy rating and estimated the long distance company would see earnings growth of 20 percent through the year 2000.
That compares to an average 11 percent earnings growth rate among its major rivals, analyst James Noble said in published commments.
Noble said he expected LCI to outperform other telecom stocks and had set a 12-month target price of $28. At noon Wednesday, LCI traded at 22-9/16, even on the day.
LCI's strategy is to offer services at prices equal to or lower than the Big 3 -- AT&T Corp, MCI Communications Corp and Sprint Corp.

As LCI activates the fiber network capacity it recently acquired from IXC Communications Inc, LCI's cost structure should improve as it owns, rather than leases, a greater percentage of its network facilities, he noted.
